notes: Dashboard sections are now collapsible - tap any card title to tuck it away or bring it back. Your layout is remembered. Everyday essentials (stats, next debt, progress, payment log) always stay visible; secondary sections like Budget and Backup start tucked away to cut scrolling roughly in half on phones.
The floating button is now smarter: when you haven't added any debts yet it says '+ Add Debt' and takes you straight to the form; once you have debts it becomes '+ Log Payment' as before.
